verdicts.note: She has held no office beyond PCO [S1], but she runs on legal and mediation credentials rather than on newness [S3][S4]. +1 rather than +2 is right.

Genuinely mixed. She uses strong restraint language on OnBase ('appalled by the waste of taxpayer money', 'more disciplined with public funds') [S5]. She also proposes a new Legal Aid Department whose listed funding includes county appropriations [S6], a Lawyer of the Day program [S7] and a dispute-resolution center [S9]. Offset funding pulls the new programs toward the middle, not toward restraint, so 0 medium stands.
